findings.message: The _launch_playtest method in play_shell.gd (line 343) creates players array but doesn't validate that _profile is not null before using it. If _profile is null, line 351 will fail with a null reference error. Consider adding a null check before line 350.

The Session class constructor and mode assignment could benefit from validation that the session_id is non-empty and that the world_id exists in the project. Currently relies on callers to provide valid inputs.
The contract test in run_playtest_service_contract_test.gd correctly verifies both solo (PLAY) and co-op (CO_OP) modes. The test coverage for edge cases (unknown world, empty world) is comprehensive.

acceptance_criteria.playtest_launch_one_action: PASS - Both create_shell.gd (line 562) and play_shell.gd (line 310) provide one-click playtest launch via _launch_playtest method. No multi-step workflow required.
acceptance_criteria.session_runtime_local_solo: PASS - RunPlaytestService.execute() correctly creates Session with mode=PLAY for single player. Verified in contract test lines 60-69.
acceptance_criteria.session_runtime_local_coop: PASS - RunPlaytestService.execute() creates Session with mode=CO_OP for two players. Verified in contract test lines 71-80.

checklist.hexagonal_boundaries: PASS - RunPlaytestService extends RunPlaytestPort (not Node), only depends on ProjectStorePort and ClockPort. No Godot-specific imports in application layer.
checklist.kid_safety_and_parental_controls: PASS - Local co-op explicitly allows parent+kid combination (line 51-52 in contract test). Parent profile can participate in local multiplayer without network access.
checklist.one_click_flow: PASS - UI integration in create_shell.gd and play_shell.gd provides direct _launch_playtest calls from button press. No intermediate dialogs or confirmations required.
checklist.error_handling: PASS - Service returns null for unknown worlds (line 20-21) and empty worlds (line 27-28). Callers check for null session and display appropriate messages (create_shell.gd:777-782).

compatibility_verification.play_shell_integration: COMPATIBLE - play_shell.gd uses RunPlaytestPort through _run_playtest_port. Launch flow matches create_shell pattern.
compatibility_verification.session_mode_enum: COMPATIBLE - Session.SessionMode.PLAY and CO_OP are used consistently across service, tests, and UI.
compatibility_verification.localization_support: COMPATIBLE - Polish localization includes all playtest-related strings (lines 140-147 in polish_localization_policy.gd).

summary: TASK-024 implementation provides a clean one-click playtest flow for both solo and local co-op sessions. The RunPlaytestService correctly validates world existence and content before launching, and contract tests cover all acceptance criteria. Two low-severity findings identify potential null-reference edge cases that should be addressed in future maintenance. Overall: APPROVE. The implementation meets all acceptance criteria and follows hexagonal architecture principles.
